question: In Microsoft PowerPoint, what is the shortcut key combination to insert a new slide in a presentation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + M**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + M** is the shortcut key combination to insert a new slide in a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation.
 
• Using this shortcut allows users to quickly add new slides without navigating through the menu options, thereby enhancing productivity and efficiency.
 
• This shortcut works in most versions of Microsoft PowerPoint, including PowerPoint 2010, 2013, 2016, 2019, and Microsoft 365.
 
• When you press **Ctrl + M**, a new slide is inserted immediately after the currently selected slide.
 
• It is particularly useful during live presentations and meetings when time is of the essence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl + N** is used to create a new presentation in Microsoft PowerPoint.
 
• **Ctrl + D** duplicates the currently selected slide in Microsoft PowerPoint.
 
• **Ctrl + I** is used to italicize the selected text in Microsoft PowerPoint.
 
• Knowing and using keyboard shortcuts can greatly improve your efficiency when working with software applications.
